structure: scene + action + temporal progression + camera + style
strong_at: open video workflows and prompt-engineered text-to-video
hint: Use concrete action verbs, temporal ordering and camera direction; avoid static image-only wording.

structure: subject + composition + photographic/art detail + light/material
hint: Prioritize clear subject, spatial relationships, materials, lighting and camera language.

structure: descriptive natural language + visual intent
strong_at: conceptual image generation, styles, visual examples
hint: Describe the full scene and desired visual intent; preserve source attribution when adapting examples.

structure: natural language + layout/text constraints + materials/lighting
hint: State subject, composition, exact text/layout, materials, lighting, camera, and what must remain unchanged.

structure: subject/action + camera + motion intensity + scene
hint: Use explicit action verbs, camera movement and motion intensity.

structure: creative intent + shot design + camera/motion control + character consistency + temporal beat + edit/extend constraints
strong_at: cinematic ads, camera moves, character consistency, Seedance/Kling workflows
hint: State the cinematic objective first, then camera/motion behavior, identity consistency, timing, and edit/extend constraints. Avoid mixing incompatible camera moves.

structure: scene + subject motion + camera + style + temporal consistency
strong_at: open video generation and stylized motion workflows
hint: Specify continuous motion, camera behavior and visual style without contradictory actions.

structure: subject + composition + explicit typography/text + design style
hint: Quote exact text, state placement/hierarchy, then describe design style, subject and composition.

structure: start state + action/physics + camera + end state
hint: Describe motion mechanics and end state clearly; avoid conflicting movement instructions.

structure: shot/scene + subject action + camera movement + temporal beats + dialogue/audio + settings
strong_at: reproducible video prompts, camera movement, product video, dialogue and synchronized audio
hint: Describe one temporal sequence at a time, keep camera motion separate from subject motion, and preserve generation settings/provenance.

structure: scene + subject motion + camera path
hint: Describe the camera path and one dominant subject motion.

structure: concise visual phrase + style + composition + parameters
hint: Use concise visual descriptors; add aspect ratio and stylization parameters only when relevant.

structure: scene + action + camera + visual mood + duration-aware progression
hint: Favor a coherent single scene with explicit action and camera movement.

structure: scene + subject + environment + light + camera/lens + edit constraints
hint: Be explicit about what changes and what stays fixed; specify angle, lens and lighting.

structure: subject transformation/motion + camera + effect
hint: Keep the central transformation/effect explicit and concise.

structure: deliverable/use-case + goal + scene/subject + style + composition + exact text/data + constraints
strong_at: text-heavy layouts, multilingual typography, e-commerce, infographics, consistent series
hint: Define the deliverable first, quote exact on-image copy, state hierarchy and constraints, and separate facts from visual style.

structure: subject motion + camera motion + scene motion
hint: If an input image already defines appearance, spend text budget on motion and camera behavior.

structure: shot sequence + subject action + camera movement + timing/transitions
strong_at: cinematic sequence, ads, UGC, multi-shot motion
hint: Write the temporal sequence explicitly and separate subject motion from camera motion.

structure: subject + style + layout + commercial design/text
hint: Specify layout hierarchy, key text, brand mood, subject and visual style.

structure: scene progression + action + camera + cinematic detail
strong_at: coherent scene development and cinematic direction
hint: Describe how the scene evolves over time, not just a static frame.

structure: positive prompt + optional negative prompt + model/sampler context
hint: Keep positive and negative concepts separable and preserve model-specific parameters outside the semantic prompt.

structure: shot + camera + action + environment + cinematic treatment + audio if needed
strong_at: cinematic scene direction and audiovisual prompting
hint: Define shot type, camera behavior, action, environment and optional dialogue/audio.

structure: subject + action + camera + scene + temporal transition
hint: Keep motion, scene and camera instructions distinct.

structure: subject + visual style + composition + lighting + material/camera
strong_at: fast image generation and editing workflows
hint: Keep subject and composition explicit; use precise material, lighting and edit-preservation language.
